courses.title: Paramedic to RN Bridge Concepts
courses.requisites: Admission to the bridge (NC or National Registry Paramedic, TEAS ≥ 59, GPA ≥ 2.5)
courses.description: Introduces the three domains of the individual, healthcare and nursing as the paramedic transitions to the nursing role: evidence-based practice, quality improvement, communication, safety, the interdisciplinary team, clinical decision-making, professional behaviors, informatics, assessment, perfusion, oxygenation, elimination and cellular regulation. A B or better converts to credit for NUR 111, 112, 114 and 117 (20 credits).
